zh-CN: 新增演奏模式：六种音色、鼓垫与鼓机、八个可选片段槽位、18 首预设和 36 个素材。
支持自动保存个人作品、最近删除恢复及工程和 WAV 导出；演奏时协调模拟声浪，提供中英文界面。
en: Add Performance with six instruments, drum pads and a sequencer, eight assignable clip slots, 18 presets and 36 clips.
Autosave personal works, restore deleted works and export projects or WAV audio, with Typing Sounds coordination and bilingual controls.
